name: Fukuroi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fukuroi city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green and blue with a white stylised leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Fukuroi, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 June 2005.

features.role: Fukuroi city emblem — a disc of green and blue with a white stylised leaf
